method: Bayesian calibration of the physics energy model on the logged trips' SoC drops (Laplace posterior), then the Monte Carlo on fixed reference routes. Usable capacity = kWh per 100 SoC points as the vehicle's own gauge counts them.

validation.label: REAL: BMW i3 ground truth from integrated measured current
validation.summary: Passport estimate 19.39 kWh (80 % CI 17.97-20.53) vs measured 22.7 kWh per 100 SoC points (-14.6 %); truth inside the 95 % interval: False. The model caps usable capacity at 1.05 x nominal = 22.68 kWh. On its own logged trips this car drove 142.2 km per 100 SoC points (measured, German conditions incl. winter heating); the Indian-route ranges above are model outputs NOT validated against measured Indian driving, and the capacity bias suggests the model under-predicts this car's consumption.
